image: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: source frame for an animated macOS desktop companion. Create ONE chibi anime swordsman strongly inspired by Inosuke Hashibira from Demon Slayer: shaggy gray boar-head mask with prominent pink snout, sharp ivory tusks, pointed furry ears and fierce icy-blue eyes; compact athletic bare torso, shaggy brown fur pelt at waist, loose charcoal hakama trousers, furry brown leg wraps and simple bare toes, exactly TWO chipped serrated silver katana blades with wrapped handles, one in each hand. Personality conveyed: wild, proud, competitive, funny bravado, confident chest forward. Hand-drawn high-quality 2D anime cel shading, clean dark outline, charming approximately 3.3 heads tall proportions. Full body in a RIGHT-FACING three-quarter side profile, relaxed ready-to-walk stance, both feet planted on the same invisible horizontal ground line, both swords held low beside the body with tips angled slightly forward but ABOVE the feet. Entire character including ears, both blade tips and feet fully visible. Portrait 9:16 composition. Character height 64% of canvas, centered horizontally, top at 18% and soles at 82% with generous empty margins for animated sword swings. Fixed orthographic side camera. Absolutely uniform flat vivid chroma green #00FF00 background, no gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow, environment, text, labels or watermark. No green anywhere in the character. Only one character, exactly two arms and two legs, no additional weapons.

walk-inosuke-01.prompt: Animate this exact chibi boar-masked dual-sword anime character. Preserve its design, proportions, blue eyes, pink snout, gray fur, bare torso, brown pelt, dark trousers, furry calves, bare toes, and exactly TWO serrated silver swords. Locked orthographic side camera, portrait 9:16, NO cuts, pans, zooms, perspective shifts, camera shake or changes of scale. Entire character and both blade tips visible within canvas at every moment, keep generous margins. Keep character's center at the same horizontal screen position (animation IN PLACE; the desktop app moves it). Remain facing RIGHT in three-quarter profile. Uniform pure vivid chroma green #00FF00 background in EVERY frame, with no floor, shadow, gradients, environment, lettering or green anywhere on character or effects. Clean 2D anime cel animation. 10 second full-body animation: 0-1.5 seconds proud idle breathing, a tiny impatient head bob and shoulder flex. 1.5-2 seconds start an energetic stomping RIGHTWARD walk IN PLACE. 2-7.5 seconds continuous natural alternating steps, swinging bent knees and subtle counter-swing arms safely holding the two blades low at his sides, fierce energetic confident swagger. 7.5-8.5 seconds smoothly slow to a stop. 8.5-10 seconds settle into the exact initial proud ready stance. The lowest planted foot stays at the initial ground level. No jumping, no turning around. No effects.
